# Contributing

Use this repo for Cloudroom app issues and pull requests, not BB's tracker.

- Include steps to reproduce, what you expected, what happened, and logs. Remove credentials and personal data.
- Keep changes focused. Open an issue before big changes.
- Build and check your change with [gui/README.md](../gui/README.md), and say what you tested.
- Keep upstream copyright and license notices. Never commit credentials, runtime data, or build output.

Development happens in a private monorepo. Each release publishes its source here. Accepted pull requests go into the monorepo before the next release.
